By popular demand, this Thursday on VSRF LIVE, we are continuing our discussion of Turbo Cancers caused by the Covid-19 Vaccine. This week, Steve Kirsch will speak with leading FLCCC physician, our friend, Dr. Paul Marik, MD. As these cancers are a ticking time bomb on hundreds of millions of Americans and billions across the globe, we need to learn how to mitigate the risk, regardless of our vaccination status. Also joining us this week will be Teacher’s for Choice founder, Michael Kane—one of Defeat the Mandates’ fearless New York leaders who will give us an update on Governor Kathy Hochul’s plans to introduce quarantine camps, possibly during the all-important 2024 election year.
Dr. Paul E. Marik, MD, FCCM, FCCP, is a distinguished physician known for pioneering a lifesaving sepsis protocol, addressing a condition causing over 250,000 deaths annually in the U.S. His expertise spans various medical fields, including Internal Medicine, Critical Care, and Neurocritical Care. Formerly a tenured Professor at Eastern Virginia Medical School, he retired in January 2022 to lead FLCCC. With a notable commitment to research and education, Dr. Marik has authored 500+ peer-reviewed articles, 80 book chapters, and four critical care books. Recognized as the second most published critical care physician globally, he received the 2017 National Teacher of the Year award and a commendation from the Virginia House of Delegates in March 2022 for his courageous treatment of COVID-19 patients.
